title: Open Cloze: The Rise of the Bicycle (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj ponizszy tekst. Uzupelnij kazda luke (1.1.-1.10.) jednym wyrazem, tak aby otrzymac spojny, logiczny i poprawny jezykowo tekst. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc ortograficzna wpisywanych wyrazow.
tasks.text:
The bicycle took a surprisingly long 1.1. _________ to arrive. The wheel had been in use for thousands of years, and yet the first machine 1.2. _________ which a rider could travel any real distance did not appear until 1817. It had no pedals whatsoever: you sat on it and pushed 1.3. _________ the ground with your feet, which is exactly what a small child does on a balance bike today.

Pedals were added in the 1860s, fixed directly 1.4. _________ the front wheel, and that single decision is why the wheel then grew enormous. With no chain and no gears, a bigger wheel meant more ground covered 1.5. _________ every turn of the pedals. The result was the penny-farthing: fast, elegant, and dangerous enough that falling off it had its own name. It stayed in fashion for barely twenty years.

What replaced it, in 1885, was essentially the bicycle we ride now - two wheels of equal size, pedals in the middle, and a chain carrying the power to the back. Add air-filled tyres three years later and the design was more 1.6. _________ less finished. Very few inventions have survived a century and a 1.7. _________ with so little alteration.

Its social effects were far greater than anybody had expected. A bicycle cost 1.8. _________ less than a horse and needed no feeding, which meant that ordinary people could travel beyond the village they had been born in. It also, 1.9. _________ the annoyance of a good many people, gave women a freedom of movement they had never previously had. One American campaigner claimed that the bicycle had done more to free women 1.10. _________ anything else in the world.
